description: This file defines the PaymentMethod controller class for handling checkout payment method interactions, including displaying payment options, validating selections, saving choices, and handling comments within the Opencart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class that manages the payment method selection, validation, and submission processes during checkout.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the payment method selection view with the current session data and information text.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods based on the current cart and session state, returning JSON response.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the selected payment method into the session after validating cart and session data.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Allows adding a comment to the order, updating the order record and session.

methods.name: agree
methods.description: Records user's agreement to terms in the session.
